tolerances.comment: f_at_h_true is ~1e-17 rad by construction; the 1e-12 budget is for a port using a different universal-variable solver, not for noise in this one. solve_h_rel is what the ROOT FIND must achieve, given the bracket [0.80, 1.20]*h_true is monotonic in every case here. The /2 levers and gate are pure arithmetic on frozen arrays -- no solver, no ephemeris -- so 1e-12 there is a real requirement, not a budget for a different implementation.

gate_cases.note: Evaluate theta_max at the grid cell's LOWER r edge, not its centre: the buffer is dominated by the r-cell, and the lower edge is exact where a centre value needs a 2.8x blind pad.
gate_cases.parallax_note: closed_form bounds the BARYCENTRIC set. Against TOPOCENTRIC sky positions it is short by the observer's parallax, which cancels only at integer years -- see topocentric_excess.
